Description

A substantial five-bedroom, three bathroom house extending to approximately 2652 sq. ft, benefitting from off-street parking for two cars. Arranged over three floors, the property provides excellent living space, centred around a stunning open-plan kitchen/family room with direct access to a landscaped south-facing garden.

Magdalen Road is situated within the highly sought after Magdalen Estate, ideally situated between Wandsworth Common and Earlsfield. Both Earlsfield and Wandsworth Common stations are within easy reach, providing regular direct services to Central London and beyond. The green open spaces of Wandsworth Common are just a short walk away, as well as the shops and restaurants of Bellevue Road. The property is also well positioned for a number of excellent local schools, such as Beatrix Potter and Earlsfield Primary School close by.

About Carter Jonas, Wandsworth

19 Bellevue Road, London, SW17 7EG
Industry affiliations:

Your Wandsworth estate agents

Our Wandsworth estate agents have been connecting people and property across the Borough of Wandsworth for decades, delivering expert advice and exceptional service to buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants alike. With a reputation built on professionalism, integrity and results, our approachable and highly experienced team is committed to making every property transaction as seamless and efficient as possible.

Our office has long been a trusted presence in the local property market, reliably offering informed advice tailored to the unique character of each neighbourhood. Many of our team members live and work within the communities they serve, giving them an unrivalled understanding of the area's property landscape and lifestyle offering.

Our estate agent services include:

- Residential Sales

- RICS Valuation Services

- Residential Lettings

- New Homes

- Property and Portfolio Management

Why live in Wandsworth?

Wandsworth is a well-connected, relaxed South West London residential area, and arguably one of the most popular and family-oriented boroughs of London. Wandsworth benefits from an abundance of green open spaces, an exquisite riverfront, excellent state and independent schools, fantastic Victorian and Edwardian housing stock, and plenty of exciting new build schemes, such as Battersea Power Station and the RAM Quarter.

At the heart of Wandsworth Common lies Bellevue Village with its parade of independents shops, café’s and renowned restaurants. Close by, Battersea’s fashionable Northecote Road boasts a series of independent cafes, shops, bars and restaurants, with a buzzing market also nearby in Balham and Tooting.
